pattern_observations.evidence: WCE Perth ODELO +2.4 (HIGH, 16 games). Won only 2 of 16 at Perth in ODELO tracking. Generic HGA for Perth Stadium is +11.3 — WCE's actual ODELO is 8.9pts below this, suggesting the Perth advantage is team-quality dependent not venue-inherent.
